name: TileFlow Sorting Products
author: contentlabs

sections.description:
TileFlow Sorting Products is a plugin designed to manage and sort products using drag-and-drop functionality. It provides an intuitive interface for organizing products in WordPress.

Features

  • Drag-and-drop product sorting
  • Intuitive admin interface
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Compatible with the latest WordPress versions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/tileflow-sorting-products directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings to configure and start sorting products.
sections.faq:
What is the minimum WordPress version required?

The plugin requires WordPress 5.0 or newer.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WooCommerce for product sorting.
